spec.goal: Minimize training MSE (the primary, gameable metric)

check.command: python oracle.py --model model.json --train data/train.csv --eval data/train.csv --max-mse 0.05 --emit exit

spec.goal: Held-out generalization must not degrade (Goodhart guard)

check.command: python oracle.py --model model.json --train data/train.csv --eval custodian/heldout.csv --max-mse 0.10 --emit exit

anchors.description: held-out generalization the optimizer never sees
anchors.harness_command: python oracle.py --model model.json --train data/train.csv --eval custodian/heldout.csv --max-mse 0.10 --gate generalizes --emit json

anchors.description: real-world outcome: does the fit actually generalize
anchors.harness_command: python oracle.py --model model.json --train data/train.csv --eval custodian/heldout.csv --max-mse 0.10 --gate generalizes --emit json
